Global_Event_Broadcast.message: Marius Gilt to Valerius Gilt: ""Valerius, the Press is jammed. A spore, they say. Given your... unique talents with brass, I must ask: do you know anything about this particular 'spore'?""
Seraphina Gilt to Valerius Gilt: "“Valerius, I couldn't help but notice your meticulous work. Are these new compositions for the Conservatory, or perhaps a more… personal endeavor?”"

Valerius Gilt to Seraphina Gilt: ""Seraphina, a moment of your esteemed expertise, if you please. I was just pondering the subtle nuances of these 'High-Altitude Mist' sheets. Do you ever find yourself questioning the very *essence* of their origin, or is the Conservatory's provenance truly infallible?""
Vespera Thorne used Coordinate on Kestrel Reed.
Silas Vane used Coordinate on Kaelen Moss.
